jobs.title: QA Engineer II – VALORANT Foundations, Engine
jobs.description:
At Riot, we believe Quality is a set of values, practices, and behaviors that inform every part of the development process. By honing our craft of quality and demonstrating cross-discipline partnerships, we help Riot sustainably craft excellent experiences for players. You will work with your team of software engineers, content developers, artists, producers and product managers to create value for players around the world. You will be guided by Riot's Test Policy to ensure the execution of quality activities at every stage of the software development life cycle.

As a QA Engineer II for the Engine team on VALORANT, you will be accountable for ensuring that design and delivery intent is clearly understood by the teams involved, risks to quality are highlighted early and often, and that you have sufficient and effective test strategies, test plans, information, and resources to accomplish the team’s quality goals for your product[s]. You will also be responsible for reporting on product quality and using that data to identify and implement quality improvements to the team’s development process. Additionally, you will partner with remote QA teams to ensure features are delivered at a high quality bar. You will report to the Quality Manager for the project in Sydney.

Responsibilities:

  • Map your team's work to quality targets based on product goals, while driving visibility on progress
  • Collect, track, analyze, and report quality metrics to stakeholders that provide measurable and actionable test data
  • Proactively identify and highlight quality concerns & risks to product stakeholders, and collaborate to develop risk mitigation strategies
  • Analyze crash reports and debug logs to identify root causes, triage engine issues, and provide clear next steps for engineering teams
  • Communicate progress of assigned tasks, and blockers to you and your team's work
  • Triage, monitor, and prioritize the defect database
  • Improve on methods of test execution at the team-level
  • Provide feedback on content and code being developed
  • Author test plans and oversee test execution, working together with test partners around the world to ensure all necessary testing is completed at the quality bar the team has set
  • Work with your team, the broader VALORANT org, and your test partners to coach a quality mindset and maintain a high quality bar in your domain space

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance
  • 1+ years working with game engines, related applications or equivalent experience
  • Experience engaging in technical design discussions, partnering with engineering-focused teams to build technical quality solutions including test harnesses, validation tools, and debugging workflows
  • Experience designing and executing test plans from both a whitebox

jobs.title: QA Engineer - Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)
jobs.description:
关于我们

我们以卓越的游戏品质为核心，致力于为全球玩家带来绝佳体验。作为Riot中国在研项目组的一员，你将在多元化环境中与开发、美术、策划等协同，聚焦高效测试与问题排查，推动项目稳定高质量上线。我们重视专业成长与团队合作，欢迎严谨、热爱游戏的你加入！

岗位职责

  • 参与项目功能测试，包括用例设计、测试执行与结果评估，确保产品各环节质量可控；
  • 跟踪并详细记录游戏Bug，推动缺陷的及时修复和回归验证，保障关键问题闭环；
  • 针对新需求、版本更新进行覆盖性测试，分析和定位复杂问题，提出合理测试改进建议；
  • 熟练使用测试、缺陷管理和协作工具（如JIRA、TestRail、禅道等），提升测试效率；
  • 与开发、美术、策划等岗位紧密协作，积极沟通推动测试流程与体验优化；
  • 关注前沿游戏测试方法与行业动态，持续总结测试经验、提升测试流程。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历，2年以上游戏测试相关工作经验，对游戏功能、玩法及体验有强烈敏感度；
  • 熟悉主流软件测试方法、流程及用例设计原则，具备扎实的测试理论基础；
  • 能熟练使用缺陷管理、测试协作等相关工具；
  • 具备良好逻辑分析与问题定位能力，能独立承担模块或专项测试任务；
  • 责任心强，工作细致认真，乐于主动发现问题并推动解决；
  • 具备良好的沟通与团队协作能力，有跨部门联动经验优先；
  • 注重结果复盘与经验沉淀，持续学习提升自身测试能力。

加分项

  • 有自动化测试、性能测试、接口测试等专项测试实操经验；
  • 有Unreal Engine（UE5）引擎项目或英雄联盟IP相关产品测试经验；
  • 熟悉脚本语言或工具开发，有自研测试工具经验；
  • 有国际化项目、多端适配或跨文化项目协作背景；
  • 英语口语流利，能阅读或编写英文测试文档。

jobs.title: Recruiter - Games (Contract)
jobs.description:
Riot Games Shanghai is both our China publishing headquarters and a world-class development studio shaping the future of play. Established in 2015 with just 20 Rioters, we have grown into a team of over 200 passionate professionals across game development, publishing, entertainment, enterprise, and esports, all working together to craft incredible experiences for players in China and around the world.

Located in downtown Shanghai with a stunning view of the Bund, our office is a hub for creativity, innovation, and collaboration. With the launch of Shanghai Game Studio in 2021 and the expansion of the China Game Studio Group in 2022, we continue to grow our capabilities and build games that will inspire players for decades.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, game-loving professionals who challenge convention, take play seriously, and are ready to help us make bold ideas a reality.

That's where you come in.

Recruiters at Riot are trusted partners who blend craft expertise with strategic insight to shape how we find and hire world-class talent. We build strong partnerships with our teams, deeply understand their needs, and guide them through every stage of the hiring journey. Our recruiters act as brand ambassadors, problem solvers, and advocates for an outstanding candidate experience, while continually improving how we recruit across Riot.

As a Recruiter - Games (Contract) on the China Game Studio Recruiting Team, you will lead recruiting efforts for both contract and full-time positions supporting our game development teams. You'll partner closely with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to attract and hire exceptional talent across a wide range of disciplines. Drawing on your recruiting expertise, you'll develop sourcing strategies, advise hiring teams on market insights and hiring approaches, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Your work will play a critical role in building high-performing teams that create exceptional experiences for players around the world.

You will report to the APAC Recruiting Lead.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead full-cycle recruitment for both contract and full-time hiring across multiple game development disciplines.
  • Partner with hiring managers and business stakeholders to develop hiring strategies and deliver against hiring goals.
  • Build and maintain diverse, high-quality talent pipelines through proactive sourcing of passive candidates globally.
  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including intake meetings, sourcing, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience through clear communication, thoughtful engagement, and efficient hiring processes.
  • Partner with People team stakeholders to continuously improve recruiting

This involves critical accounting player life estimates, big data transaction reconciliation and automation for micropayments, devising structure to address controls and risks including for accounts receivable, and thoughtfully developing the technical accounting for emerging revenue issues. You will drive projects forward and collaborate with other teams including Finance, Game teams, Payments, Legal, Data, and accounting teams in our global offices.

This position reports to the Accounting Director and will play a key leadership role in the overall Accounting organization around change management, improving processes and controls, scaling accounting, company infrastructure and operations.

jobs.title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. We relish the opportunity to work with low-level systems and take pride in developing creative, rigorous defenses against adversaries. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

Required Qualifications:

  • Proficient in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly
  • Experience building and debugging low-level, security-sensitive systems
  • Strong understanding of Windows process internals, including process and thread lifecycles, virtual memory, handles and objects, security contexts, executable image formats, DLL loading, and the Windows loader
  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience within cheat-development or game-security research communities, with practical knowledge of modern cheat techniques

jobs.title: Senior Concept Artist, Environment - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
我们以玩家体验为核心，致力于用创新技术为全球玩家带来卓越的游戏体验。作为 Unpublished R&D Product 团队的一员，你将与客户端、引擎、美术、设计及跨职能团队紧密合作，围绕 UE5 前沿能力开展研究与工程化实践，持续完善高品质、稳定高效的视觉设计流程。

我们正在寻找能够"构建设计体验，而不仅是绘制场景"的设计师。

作为一名优秀的场景设计师，你将从空间体验与视觉表达出发，定义环境设计的视觉语言，与美术、设计、叙事及技术团队紧密合作，打造兼具沉浸感、可读性与制作可行性的高品质环境内容。

我们希望你不仅具备出色的视觉表达能力，更具备系统化的空间设计思维，能够在艺术表现、设计需求与技术约束之间建立平衡。

You will report into the Creative Director of the team.

Responsibilities

Environment Design

  • 负责核心场景内容的概念设计，从草图探索到高完成度场景设定。
  • 探索并定义符合设计方向的环境视觉语言，包括地形结构、建筑风格、材质表现、色彩氛围等。
  • 构建具有高度辨识度和沉浸感的环境设计，支撑整体体验与视觉表达。

Design Systems & Methodology

  • 构建场景设计逻辑，包括空间布局、视觉语言、设计原则及叙事关联。
  • 建立并持续完善场景设计规范，包括尺度体系、模块化原则、细节密度及视觉引导等。
  • 在设计中平衡视觉表现、空间可读性及长期内容扩展需求。

Spatial Design & Collaboration

  • 与跨职能团队紧密合作，确保场景设计满足空间体验及整体设计目标。
  • 设计清晰的视觉引导与空间层级，提升整体体验及信息传达效率。
  • 在空间规划过程中充分考虑功能分区、视觉可读性及制作可行性。

Cross-functional Collaboration

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Creative Management - Wild Rift
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. That's where you come in.

You will lean on your years of experience to help manage one of the most ambitious, high-stakes creative teams in the industry, building some of the most robust, scalable systems, collaborative partnerships, and player-focused content.

You will work with Product Leads, Delivery Leads, Stakeholders, and the Game Director to stay aligned on vision and priorities while maintaining consistent art quality and style across the team and pipelines. The role does not create the creative direction or art vision, but oversees its execution and the evolution of art pipelines and the creative team.

  • Translate vision into actionable goals ensuring consistent alignment across each creative discipline.
  • Oversee the creation of high-quality creative content that upholds our creative vision and elevates the player experience. Step in to provide creative direction when needed to guide decisions, resolve conflicts, and model excellence, while prioritizing team growth over hands-on execution.

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Insights Analyst - Central Product Insights
jobs.description:
The Insights discipline helps empower Rioters' decision-making to be more data-informed. We're an interdisciplinary group of scientists, consultants, and strategists from all sorts of backgrounds who join together to represent and advocate for gamers around the world. We believe that illuminating the globally diverse experiences, behaviors, and needs of gamers is essential to Riot living up to our player-focused mission. We're a group united by our love of games, science, and helping others succeed.

As a Sr. Principal Insights Analyst on Central Product Insights (CPI), you will leverage deep expertise in game analytics to help our games deeply understand their products & players and to level up this craft across the portfolio of games at Riot. You'll partner with leaders on game teams across the portfolio and lifecycle as well as executives overseeing Riot’s entire games portfolio. You’ll conduct a wide range of complex analyses to help us understand the health of our products, players, and game experiences either individually or in partnership with analysts on game teams. You’ll build and manage scaled analytics tools, dashboards, and datasets that empower stakeholders across Riot’s entire portfolio. You’ll also help to define and elevate craft standards across the portfolio and guide discipline investments to help unlock the full capacity of analysts working on games.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of new, scaled analytics-based insights tools, dashboards, and datasets focusing on common game behaviors and play patterns, in collaboration with stakeholder needs across the portfolio and central executive leadership
  • Mentor and develop game analysts, both on CPI and across the portfolio

  • Support game leadership on staffing and workforce management for game analytics across the portfolio
  • Partner with insights leadership to ensure the craft of game analytics is well-supported across Riot overall

Company Introduction

Founded in 2006 by passionate entrepreneurial gamers, Riot Games centers its game development philosophy on player experience. The studio debuted League of Legends in 2009, which earned widespread critical acclaim and grew into the world’s most-played video game with over 100 million monthly active players. The global player community forms the core foundation of Riot’s business, driving continuous iteration and optimization of in-game player experience.

Role Overview

Riot Visual Designers seek to craft the best player experiences through their knowledge of graphic design, interactivity, layout, typography, color theory, and illustration. Designers collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams and act as both artistic and design problem solvers. They understand players and ask questions about the what, who and how when solving for visual communication design challenges.

As a Visual Designer for Wild Rift, you embody this approach as the execution core of the Publishing Art team. jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

  • 对实时光照、着色模型、后处理或风格化渲染有良好理解
  • 具备一定的性能优化经验，熟悉 RenderDoc、Unreal Profiler 等工具的基本使用

加分项：

  • 有 UI 技术美术相关经验（UMG、UI 材质或 UI 性能优化等）
  • 具备 LookDev 经验，理解色彩理论、相机语言
  • 有完整游戏项目上线经验

在提交申请时，请提供作品集或Demo Reel，你可能被要求完成艺术测试。

对于这个岗位，你将通过工艺专业知识、协作精神以及优先考虑玩家乐趣的决策来获得成功。我们将关注您过去的学习、经验以及您与游戏的个人关系。如果您体现了玩家的同理心并关心玩家的体验，这可能就是您的角色！

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Senior Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will build and own major components of the next generation AI cloud platform – a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products – inference, RL, and fine-tuning – and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

The hard problems in rapidly scaling heterogeneous GPU fleets are software problems: fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes. We solve them by building global and in-DC services, Kubernetes operators, and high-performance SDN libraries, forking hypervisors and Linux kernels, and building infra tailored to inference and fine-tuning. You'll own massive greenfield projects across their full lifecycle – scoping the problem and writing PRDs with our PMs, designing the system, and building it through to GA launch.

Responsibilities

  • Build the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that makes GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.
  • Build and maintain our in-DC IaaS layer: the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers, including VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions. Implement and harden the bring-up path for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs.
  • Scale the distributed GPU scheduling and global management plane: the control-plane services behind on-demand and reserved clusters, including the automation that onboards new capacity and raises per-cluster limits.
  • Harden the monitoring and automated remediation layer for fault tolerance: automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference fault-tolerant.

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Tools Programmer to evolve artist tools within the Unreal Editor, particularly in geometry and texturing processing, terrain authoring, and procedural generation. An important aspect of this role is supporting both user-driven and agentic workflows, including exploring and implementing new interaction paradigms to accelerate content creation. You'll directly impact artist productivity by developing user-facing tools for one of the leading game engines used by developers worldwide.

In this role, you will

  • Support and extend existing artist tools for internal and external users
  • Refactor existing tools to be more accessible and effective for agentic workflows
  • Create new tools at the intersection of user-driven and agent-driven content creation
  • Collaborate with artists on internal projects and productions
  • Work with other developers across team boundaries on shared initiatives
  • Contribute to major initiatives that shape the future of the Unreal Editor

What we're looking for

  • Excellent C++ skills
  • Strong background in developing artist tools within the games or film industry
  • Experience with geometry processing, texture processing, or procedural generation
  • Fluency in using current agentic tools and workflows for programming tasks
  • Track record of exploring and applying AI capabilities to advance artist workflows
  • Experience developing in a large codebase
  • Ability to work independently and deliver effectively as part of a distributed team
  • Experience working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes across teams

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Frontier AI is on track to be among the most consequential and most adversarially-targeted technology in the world. The capability curve is steep, the adversaries who want these systems are extremely well-resourced, and the security bar this will eventually require is well beyond where the industry operates today. Incremental hardening alone is not going to close that gap, so we need breakthroughs and a group of people to go find them.

Security Labs is that team. We run a portfolio of high-risk, high-expected-value security projects: the work that seems impractical until someone optimistic and stubborn enough actually tries it. Projects run on the order of weeks rather than quarters, and each one is either handed off to the Anthropic team that will own it in production or wound down with a writeup of what we learned. We expect a meaningful fraction of our bets not to land.

This team is intentionally scrappy and ambitious. We're intentionally iterating fast on high-risk research bets and we expect a meaningful fraction not to land. If a 30% project success rate sounds uncomfortable, or uncharted and chaotic territory isn’t both frightening and exciting, this probably isn't the right fit. There are other places in Anthropic Security doing important work with more structure, less risk, and more certain paths to positive outcomes.

The questions we're trying to answer include:

  • Can our core research workflows survive extreme isolation?
  • Can we replace trust with cryptographic guarantees?
  • Can the models themselves become our most effective security control?
  • What would it actually take to defend against a tier-1 state adversary, and how much of that can we build now?

Who we're looking for. We're hiring generalists with rare depth. You're a strong software engineer as a baseline, and on top of that you've gone deep in at least one area most engineers don't get near: firmware or hardware security, applied cryptography, OS / kernel / hypervisor internals, formal methods, reverse engineering, or high-assurance and cross-domain systems. You've built things under your own direction, you're comfortable jumping layers when the problem demands it, and you'd rather take a swing at something that might not work than ship the safe incremental thing. jobs.title: Senior Security IAM Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior IAM Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona. This role will focus on building, scaling, and securing Scopely’s identity and access management ecosystem across our cloud, SaaS, AI, and remote access environments, with a strong emphasis on Terraform-based IAM automation, access workflow engineering, least-privilege design, identity risk reduction, and AI-assisted operational workflows.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Build and Evolve Modern IAM Architecture

  • Design and evolve Scopely’s IAM architecture to support a high-scale, cloud-first environment across AWS, GCP, SaaS applications, AI tooling, and remote access platforms.

Lead initiatives around:

  • Federated identity architecture using SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM
  • Workforce identity and access patterns across internal platforms
  • Least-privilege role design and access segmentation
  • RBAC and ABAC models for cloud and SaaS environments
  • Centralized access models using Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Google Cloud IAM, and cloud-native IAM services
  • Secure cross-account and cross-project access patterns
  • Service account, workload identity, and non-human identity governance
  • Zero Trust identity and access control design

Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to:

  • Standardize secure identity and access patterns
  • Reduce identity sprawl and excessive permissions
  • Improve access visibility and auditability
  • Build scalable identity controls for a fast-moving engineering environment

Own Terraform-Based IAM and Access Automation

  • Own and improve Terraform-based IAM and access automation across Scopely’s cloud and identity environment.

Design, build, and maintain:

  • Reusable Terraform modules for IAM roles, policies, permission sets, group mappings, and access patterns
  • Terraform workflows for Okta app assignments, group-based access, and IAM Identity Center automation
  • Standardized access modules that can be reused safely across teams and environments
  • Policy-as-code patterns for least privilege and permission boundary enforcement
  • Terraform-driven onboarding and offboarding flows for identity-related systems
  • Automation for service account and workload identity provisi

jobs.title: Director, Technical Accounting – Investments
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking a Director, Technical Accounting – Investments and M&A to join our Finance team at Anthropic. In this role, you will own the company's accounting for strategic investments, partnerships with investment components, and related capital transactions, and support mergers and acquisitions when deal volume requires. You will report to the Senior Director, Technical Accounting – M&A and Investments.

As Anthropic continues to scale rapidly and deploy capital into strategic investments, joint ventures, and novel commercial structures, including compute arrangements that carry warrants and other investment features, you will be a key technical resource on classification, consolidation outcomes, fair value, and financial statement impact across the portfolio. You will partner closely with Corporate Development, Legal, Tax, Treasury, FP&A, and leadership to ensure that investment economics are accurately reflected under US GAAP and that positions are defensible to external auditors, valuation specialists, and future regulators.

This is a builder role: you'll help stand up and continuously sharpen the portfolio accounting process, controls, and valuation governance expected of a world class finance organization, working alongside the Senior Director as the function takes shape. If you want to own a portfolio end to end — and still be in the room when deals are shaped — we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Execute technical accounting for strategic investments, joint ventures, partnership structures, and related financing/equity instruments from entry through exit
  • Partner with and influence Corporate Development to steer investment structures toward preferred terms and outcomes, reviewing term sheets and deal documents before signing
  • Own entry accounting for each new investment — classification under ASC 321, 323, or 810, VIE/primary-beneficiary analysis, basis differences, and the initial measurement memo
  • Run the quarterly portfolio review — reconsideration events, impairment indicators, observable price changes, and equity method pick-ups — and account for follow-on investments, conversions, down rounds, and exits
  • Own the investment rollforward, its reconciliation to the general ledger, and the portfolio reporting that supports close, FP&A, and leadership, including review of portfolio company financial statements
  • Manage third-party valuation specialists; review fair values of investment

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Office of the Chief Commercial Officer is a small team that works directly with our CCO, go-to-market leadership, and company leadership on Anthropic’s highest-priority commercial initiatives. We take on problems that do not sit cleanly inside one team, such as standing up a program that spans Product, Finance, Legal, and Sales, or preparing the material our executives and Board use to make decisions. Our commercial business is growing faster than its operating processes can be built, so a growing share of the job is stepping into gaps and running something important, while making sure other teams are building the capabilities to permanently own.

You will own workstreams end to end. One week that means running the go-to-market side of a pressing situation, from the communications plan for customers and account teams to the daily readout for executives. Another week it means building the analysis behind a resourcing decision or a new program and writing it up for the CCO. This is an internal role. You will report to the CCO’s chief of staff, and you will have an unusually broad view of how the company makes decisions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive priority go-to-market initiatives from plan to delivery, removing blockers, escalating early, and connecting the right people across teams at the right time

  • Build the analysis, draft the document or deck, and turn input from many teams into a recommendation executives can act on

  • Prepare content for the CCO and leadership team, including weekly staff meetings, updates to the Office of the CEO, Board materials, and leadership offsites

  • Track the go-to-market organization’s top priorities and keep a current view of status, owners, and risks

  • Act as a bridge between go-to-market and Product, Finance, Legal, Safeguards, and Research, so that what account teams hear from customers reaches product decisions and those decisions reach account teams in a usable form

  • Step in where something important has no clear owner, run it until it has a permanent home, and hand it over cleanly

  • Close out same-day executive requests quickly and to a high standard

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a quality-focused Senior Release Manager to work closely with our producers, programmers, build programmers, and QA teams to oversee the build and release process for the Fortnite Ecosystem. In this position, you will work directly with the brightest technical minds in the business as we build the premier game engine for a multitude of platforms.

In this role, you will

  • Develop new practices and structures to better scale release management and stabilization processes across our Game Dev ecosystem, while managing a sub-team of release managers
  • Own the scheduling, coordination, quality control, and external certification process across multiple platforms and/or products
  • Act as the liaison between multiple development teams, coordinating and negotiating development plans, exceptions, sales/mktg/publishing content, as well as releases
  • Work with the publishing and development teams to determine release content plans as related to sales, giveaways, promotions, etc., and shepherd that content through external party approvals for release
  • Work closely with QA, Build Programmers, and Lead Programmers to monitor the automated build and integration process, facilitate the resolution of build failures, and understand and communicate the impact of branches and code merges
  • Partner with QA Leads to establish and maintain the bug triage process and prioritize must-fix issues, coordinate internal and external release notes, known issues, and knowledge base updates, and ensure releases have passed all required checks and approvals leading up to live deployment, while communicating approved exceptions to all necessary parties

What we're looking for

  • Strong production/project management skills, communication skills, and people management/direct report experience
  • Demonstrated ability in right-sized process development and improvement

We are looking for a Discovery Technical Operations Specialist to join our Litigation and Regulatory team and help build out Anthropic's discovery operations from the ground up, support active matters, and help drive information governance maturation. This is a unique opportunity to be a part of a critical function at one of the most closely watched companies in the world. You will work hand-in-hand with our discovery leads, litigation and regulatory counsel, outside counsel, discovery vendors, and cross-functional partners such as Security and IT to manage retention, preservation, collection, and production of electronically stored information (ESI) across active matters. Beyond matter-level support and programmatic development of discovery systems and processes, you will also help execute the development of Anthropic's broader information governance program, including data classification standards and defensible disposal practices that keep pace with a rapidly scaling AI company's evolving data landscape.

The right person for this role will be equal parts technical operator and operational project manager.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and operate discovery operations across the full EDRM lifecycle (preservation, collection, processing, hosting, review, and production including for novel and AI-specific data types)

  • Support the operational design and execution of the legal hold program including custodian identification workflows, hold issuance and tracking, periodic re-notification, custodian acknowledgments, and defensible release

  • Support and improve the discovery technology stack including RelativityOne, in-place preservation and collection tooling across Slack, Google Workspace, and internal systems, and supporting analytics and review platforms including configuration, access controls, templates, and reusable workspaces

  • Partner with discovery team, in-house counsel, outside counsel, vendors, and internal technical teams; coordinate matter execution, status, and escalations

  • Partner with Security, IT, and product engineering to support Anthro

jobs.title: Onboarding Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

New hires join Anthropic every week; their first days here shape how they understand our mission and culture, and help to accelerate their time to productivity. We're looking for a Program Manager to own the live delivery of our new hire onboarding program, so that every cohort, whatever its size or timing, gets an experience that is well run, welcoming, and grounded in what makes Anthropic distinctive.

You'll own our San Francisco onboarding program end to end: facilitating sessions, overseeing the operating rhythm behind each cohort, and orchestrating across Recruiting, People Services, Workplace, IT, and the many presenters who bring the program to life. You'll work within our overall onboarding strategy and program design, and your job is to deliver our live onboarding program reliably, week after week, while spotting where the experience can get better and feeding those insights into how the program evolves.

This role suits someone who loves the craft of running a great program: the preparation, the moments in the room, and the systems that make it all repeatable at scale. You'll do well here if you stay calm when plans change, care deeply about the details that shape a first impression, and bring warmth and clarity to a room of people on their first day.

This role requires being in the office at least two days a week – on all programming days and as needed otherwise.

Key responsibilities

  • Own weekly program delivery: Run each onboarding cohort from pre-arrival readiness through program close, so every cohort gets a consistent, high-quality experience

  • Facilitate live sessions: Serve as the primary facilitator and host for every cohort, setting the tone for new hires and keeping the program on time and on message

  • Support presenters and facilitators: Brief and prepare the speakers, panelists, and backup facilitators who deliver program content, so sessions land well regardless of who is in the room; deliver feedback as needed and support content iteration

  • Oversee cross-functional execution: Partner closely with the NHO coordinator to coordinate across Recruiting, People Services, Workplace, IT, and AV, so that start dates, device readiness, rooms, catering, and communications come together each week

  • Set the weekly operating rhythm: Prioritize and sequence program logistics and coordination

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a QA Analyst to join our Monopoly Go! team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Monopoly GO! is our new casual game and a key franchise that has just become one of Scopely’s largest games enjoyed by millions of players. The team is based in Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players.

What You Will Do

Reporting to your Vertical Group QA Lead of Live Minigames, you will play a vital role in upholding quality standards within one of Monopoly Go’s tightly integrated teams, known as a Pod. Collaborating with both internal and external partners, you’ll support regular feature and content releases, from initial concept through to post-release support, ensuring that the highest quality is maintained throughout.

As a key advocate for quality at Scopely, you will help shape our ongoing commitment to excellence.

  • Ensure your pod’s contributions to each release meet the highest standard of quality, focusing on both defect prevention and overall user experience, while also maintaining a broad, holistic view of release quality across the wider team
  • Develop clear and comprehensive test plans that define scope of coverage, accurate time estimates, resourcing needs, tooling / cheat needs, and any wider requirements to support testing from concept through to release
  • Drive the creation, upkeep, and execution of test suites and cases tailored to your pod’s specific needs and evolving scope
  • Support and adopt AI-driven QA initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, coverage, and reporting
  • Maintain a clean and prioritized bug database in alignment with your pod’s work
  • Lead the onboarding of external embedded QA resources into your pod, ensuring they are set up for success and aligned with internal processes, while fostering a strong working relationship to remain aligned on priorities at all times
  • Take ownership of your pod’s quality output by leading through example, performing hands-on testing, and ensuring accountability at all stages of development

  • Facilitate pod-specific playtests to gather broader feedback, track issues effectively, and ensure follow-up actions are taken where needed
  • Collaborate with Customer Support and the Live & Release teams to investigate live issues, advocating for timely resolutions while addressing root causes

jobs.title: Lead Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
Scopely is seeking an experienced Lead Analyst / Finance Manager to join Product Finance in support of our LIVE Games Portfolio — a group of live-operated, top-grossing mobile games generating meaningful revenue for Scopely. This is a senior, high-visibility role for someone ready to operate as a true finance business partner: owning financial models end-to-end, driving KPI and performance reporting, and initiating the projects that shape how the portfolio is managed.

You will partner directly with General Managers and cross-functional stakeholders across game studios, User Acquisition, Data Science and Finance leadership, Accounting, and central teams. You will be a key voice in portfolio-level decision-making, translating data and models into clear recommendations for senior leadership. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, exhibit the highest personal and professional integrity, and work effectively with supervision while independently managing recurring monthly and quarterly deliverables.

Unlike an entry-level analyst role, this position calls for someone who can operate with a high degree of autonomy — identifying problems, initiating and leading projects, and managing senior stakeholders across the organization with minimal oversight, while still delivering the operational rigor (forecasting, close support, variance analysis) that keeps the portfolio running smoothly

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Strategic Ownership: Own end-to-end financial modeling, forecasting, and reporting for titles within the LIVE Games Portfolio, presenting directly to senior game and finance leadership.
  • Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary finance point of contact for a broad set of cross-functional partners — game GMs, UA, Data/BI, Accounting — building the trusted relationships that shape business decisions.
  • Project Initiation: Identify opportunities and lead process improvement and automation projects — forecasting model redesigns, KPI dashboard builds, reporting infrastructure — from scoping through execution.
  • Global Portfolio Exposure: Work across Scopely's live games portfolio from our Barcelona hub, collaborating daily with teams across the US, EMEA, and beyond.
  • Top Talent Environment: Join a high-caliber team with backgrounds in consulting, banking, private equity, and high-growth tech from companies such as Amazon, Google, and Netflix.
  • Career Trajectory: Senior individual contributors on this team have a clear path to Finance Manager / Senior Manager roles with expanding portfolio and people-leadership scope.
  • Tech-Forward Finance: Be part of an AI-powered FP&A team, contributing to the automation of reporting and the build-out of predictive, self-serve tools.

We are looking for strong rendering expertise and a passion for delivering high-quality, high-performance visuals. You will work on real-time rendering features and optimizations that help our game look and run its best across a wide range of devices.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - Stumble Guys!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using data to shape products played by millions of people around the world? Do you enjoy uncovering player insights, designing experiments, and influencing product decisions with data? If so, we'd love to meet you!

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to help shape the future of Stumble Guys, one of the world's leading mobile games. You'll join a team of Product Analysts and Analytics Engineers, partnering closely with Product Managers, Game Designers, Data Engineers, and Developers to turn player behavior into actionable insights.

From event instrumentation and data modeling to A/B testing and deep-dive analyses, you'll help answer our most challenging product questions and directly influence the future of the game.

If you're excited about working on a game played by millions of daily active users (just ask your younger cousins - they're probably already playing!), we'd love to hear from you!

We also work with a modern analytics stack including Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker and Hex.

  • Design, analyze, and communicate A/B tests to evaluate new features and optimize player experiences.
  • Develop frameworks, dashboards, and analytical tools that empower teams to make better product decisions.
  • Generate actionable insights that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and overall game performance.
  • Define and validate event tracking to ensure high-quality product analytics.
  • Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience working as a Product Analyst, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or other consumer digital products.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experimentation (A/B testing), product analytics, and statistical analysis.
  • Intellectual curiosity with a passion for solving complex business problems through data.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills—you can translate complex analyses into clear recommendations.
  • Python or R experience is a plus.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

jobs.title: Lead Technical Animator
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other initiatives as part of our collaboration with Disney. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact cosmetic assets and gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent cosmetics teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team, both internal and vendor
  • Work closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Mentor rigging-focused technical animators
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver

We are looking for a SOX Director - Compute and Infrastructure to join our Internal Audit team at Anthropic. jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and engineers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Claude is getting good at research. Given a well-posed problem, it can read the literature, write and run simulations, analyze results, and iterate on a design across physics, materials, chemistry, and engineering. But most of the hardest problems in science and engineering aren't well-posed. They live inside companies and labs with their own data, tools, constraints, and experts, and progress depends on turning all of that into work a model can actually do and check.

Our Applied AI, Science & Engineering team takes Claude to the scientists and engineers working on hard problems in energy, materials, hardware design, and other physical-world fields. We build the tools Claude needs to do real research and engineering work. Mostly that means software: the agent harnesses, integrations, evaluations, and working processes that turn a partner's problem into something Claude can make progress on and validate. We find real-world problems and test what we build through partner engagements, then feed our learnings back to our research and product teams. It's early, and the engineers who join now will shape how Claude gets applied to science and engineering.

This is an engineering role first. You'll spend real time with domain experts, become the person who knows how to get Claude working in their field, and prototype quickly alongside them. Most of your time, though, goes into building and hardening the systems that make that work repeatable, not into writing recommendations or configuring someone else's product. A science or engineering background is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert researchers, turn a fuzzy problem into something concrete and checkable, and ship.

Responsibilities

  • Build the agent harnesses and research loops that let Claude carry a problem from literature review through hypothesis generation, simulation, analysis, and design iteration
  • Connect scientific computing and simulation tools (finite element, CFD, electromagnetic, or molecular modeling codes, for example) so Claude can drive them reliably and at scale

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

Within Security GRC, Compliance & Audit Programs runs the integrated audit across our frameworks and maintains the Common Control Framework, the single set of controls that the whole program is built on. This role sits in Audit & Assurance and owns the framework and the assurance view across every control domain.

About the role

You'll work with control owners and GRC Partners to draft and validate control descriptions and activities that describe reality rather than policy intent, build the monitoring that shows operating effectiveness continuously instead of once a year, and drive what monitoring finds to closure with control owners.

Building with Claude is a normal part of the job: drafting and mapping controls, testing evidence, and monitoring control health, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who works well independently, writes clearly, and gets satisfaction from a control set that is accurate, tested, and trusted by auditors and engineers alike.

Secure Frameworks is the team in Anthropic's Security Engineering org that builds shared security libraries and frameworks the rest of the company builds on. We collaborate closely with teams and leaders across Anthropic to own critical security foundations, including workload identity and authorization, cryptographic frameworks, and the centralized access proxy that secures traffic to internal applications.

Our mission is to make the secure thing easy and the easy thing secure by helping Anthropic engineers get secure behaviour by default and preventing entire classes of vulnerabilities through careful design. We own what we ship, help customers adopt better security practices and at times we work embedded directly in research, infrastructure or product teams.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function, using automation, quantitative risk and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The risks we assess span Anthropic's full security landscape, so the team needs breadth across domains and the judgment to go deep wherever a decision demands it.   • Shape the analysis and narrative behind leadership risk reviews, and help define risk appetite and the risk metrics the organization should measure and why

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

This role sits in Compliance & Audit Programs and works one regime family, US public sector, from requirements through authorization and ongoing compliance, working alongside the public sector engineering pods rather than downstream of them.

You'll help drive the compliance programs that keep Anthropic's US government authorizations current: federal civilian (FedRAMP, including FedRAMP 20x for Claude Enterprise), Department of War (DoD impact levels, CMMC, NIST SP 800-171), and state and local (StateRAMP, TX-RAMP and agency requirements). You'll own the recurring cycles those authorizations run on (continuous monitoring, POA&M, annual assessments, significant changes), help build new authorizations as we add them, and keep every frontier model's authorizations current.

You'll turn government requirements into specific, testable requirements that engineering teams build against, review the evidence that comes back, and say so when a launch is not ready for a government boundary. Building with Claude is a normal part of the job: mapping, evidence collection and reporting, with you deciding where human judgment stays in the loop.

This is an individual contributor role, working closely with a peer on US public sector compliance, for someone who works well independently, writes clearly, and gets satisfaction from a government authorization that holds up as the product changes underneath it.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced public opinion researcher to build and expand Anthropic's in-house polling and research function. This role will be fundamental to understanding how key audiences — from policymakers and third-party groups to the general public — perceive and respond to Anthropic's policy positions, messages, and campaigns. This is a foundational role: you'll establish the research function from the ground up, with high autonomy and limited precedent.

The Central Policy team sits at the operational heart of Anthropic's policy function — distinct from government relations and communications, but essential to enabling both. You'll work cross-functionally to ensure our policy and communications strategy is grounded in a rigorous understanding of stakeholder sentiment. The polling insights you generate will directly feed into high-visibility campaigns and will be a key asset in our policy efforts in Washington and beyond.

Anthropic is equal parts research lab, policy think-tank, and technology startup. We care deeply about the safe development of AI systems and build partnerships with governments through proactive, opinionated, substantive policy conversations. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of AI policy, bringing rigorous research discipline to policy strategy.

Success in this role means establishing trusted relationships with leading polling firms around the world, delivering high-quality research on a regular cadence, and becoming the internal expert on how key audiences perceive AI, Anthropic, and Anthropic's positions and messages. You'll translate polling insights into strategic recommendations that measurably improve campaign effectiveness, and build scalable processes that allow the function to grow efficiently as demand increases.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop a comprehensive strategy for our in-house political research function that aligns with Anthropic's policy goals

  • Identify, evaluate, and establish relationships with leading research and polling firms, ensuring coverage across demographics, geographies, and political perspectives

  • Conduct detailed, proactive research to test core messages, policy proposals, and campaign themes, and to evaluate Anthropic's brand perception and performance

  • Execute rapid-response polling to quickly assess Anthropic's messaging strategy in response to external events, policymaker actions, competitive developments

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale

  • Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools

  • Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling

  • Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level

  • Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox

  • Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution

  • Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers

  • Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios

  • Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on

  • Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

Minimum qualifications

  • Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area

  • Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go

  • Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc

About Anthropic

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

Apply at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to a shared workspace
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Compensation

The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension).

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Reinforcement learning is how Claude learns to reason, write code, and act autonomously over long horizons. The RL Scaling team works on how RL scales: what happens to throughput, stability, and learning efficiency as models get larger, episodes get longer, and compute grows by orders of magnitude, and what has to change in our algorithms and systems to keep getting returns from that scale.

This role sits squarely across research and engineering. You'll develop next-generation architectures and RL algorithms, take them from a small-scale result to a frontier-scale run, and understand every place they behave differently along the way. You'll build the systems that set how fast the team can iterate: how many experiments, at what scale, and how quickly we can trust the results. And you'll work on Anthropic's largest and fastest RL runs, where the gap between a good idea and a working one is often a problem no one has solved yet.

Key responsibilities

  • Study how RL training and sampling scale with model size, context length, and compute, and find the algorithmic and systems changes that keep scaling efficient
  • Develop next-generation model architectures and RL algorithms, and make them run efficiently at frontier scale
  • Take promising small-scale results to frontier-scale runs, and diagnose why they behave differently when they get there, whether the cause is numerical, algorithmic, or systemic
  • Build the experimental infrastructure that sets research velocity: fast, reproducible comparisons of architecture and algorithm variants at meaningful scale
  • Own end-to-end performance of our largest RL runs, from research code down to the hardware
  • Build performance and cost models for proposed architecture and algorithm changes, and use them to decide which ideas get scaled
  • Investigate training dynamics at scale, including instabilities, divergence, and throughput regressions, and trace them to root cause

Minimum qualifications

  • Deep familiarity with modern transformer language models, including their architecture, training dynamics, and the behavior of large-scale optimization
  • Hands-on experience training large models in a distributed setting, including the tradeoffs between data, tensor, and pipeline parallelism
  • A track record of original technical work in ML training or systems, such as new methods, architectures, or optimizations, demonstrated through research, open-source, or production impact

jobs.title: Research Engineer / Performance Engineer, RL Distributed Systems
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Reinforcement learning is how Claude learns to reason, write code, and act autonomously over long horizons. At frontier scale, an RL run is an unusually demanding distributed system. Training, sampling, and environment execution run concurrently across a large fleet of accelerators and hosts, exchange data continuously, and have to keep making progress while hardware fails, load shifts, and the research changes underneath them. How well that system holds together determines how much of our compute turns into learning, and how quickly the team can try the next idea.

As a Research Engineer on the Distributed Systems team within RL Engineering, you'll work on whatever part of that system is the current limit. That might be scheduling and placement, data movement between components, running large numbers of sandboxed environments, storage and checkpointing, networking, fault tolerance, autoscaling, or the observability that tells us what a run is actually doing. We're looking for generalists: engineers who can move between these layers, reason from first principles about a system they haven't seen before, and pick the problem that matters most rather than the one closest to their prior experience.

Our system changes as fast as the research does, correctness under failure matters as much as throughput, and the best solutions often come from understanding the ML workload well enough to know which guarantees it actually needs. Strong candidates have built and run large distributed systems, care about getting the details right, and want to apply that experience to a workload that is very large, very heterogeneous, and changing quickly.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the distributed systems that run RL at scale, across training, sampling, and environment execution
  • Find and remove whatever currently limits the system, whether it's scheduling, data movement, storage, networking, or coordination
  • Build fault tolerance into every layer: failure detection, isolation, and recovery that keep long-running jobs making progress without human intervention
  • Design resource management and autoscaling so that compute follows demand as a run's needs shift
  • Build observability that makes it possible to understand what a run is doing and why it slowed down, stalled, or produced unexpected results
  • Build automation that detects and remediates common problems, and design interfaces that let engineers and automated tools operate runs safely
  • Work with r

jobs.title: Lead Producer
jobs.description:
WE ARE GAME MAKERS

Who We Are:

We are a diverse team of developers driven by a passion for our art, united by our core values and inspired by a culture of inclusivity to build amazing games that thrill players everywhere. We pursue growth and innovation in an environment of safety and trust, striving to deliver the highest quality experience for our players all the time. Our culture is built on the belief that the more varied voices in our collective will strengthen our team and our games. We are looking for our next teammate who will raise our bar and make us better.

What We Need:

We are seeking a Lead Producer to serve as a key leader for our production team to support our content groups (concept, modelling, FX, etc) and help define external development strategies. With an increased scope and breadth relative to other production partners, you will focus on project strategy, take accountability for managing multiple areas and crafts, and play a vital role in hiring and developing top production talent. You will need to able to quickly adjust to the game’s growing needs and at times roll up your sleeves and execute at a more granular level.

The ideal candidate is an expert planner and problem solver who can seamlessly move between long-term strategy and short-term execution. Working closely with the production, studio, and discipline leadership teams, you will ensure our teams are set up for success, help set clear objectives aligned with business goals, aggressively mitigate risk, and serve as a driving force for team health, culture, and process improvement.

What You'll Do:

  • Production Management & Delivery: Act as the production lead for multiple areas and crafts, taking accountability for the quality, upkeep, and timeliness of milestone deliveries from concept to completion.

  • Risk & Scope Mitigation: Actively identify complex development, project, or personnel issues; make tough, timely, and sometimes controversial decisions; and proactively lead discussions around managing feature or scope creep.

Need to ensure producers own their day-to-day responsibilities, uphold the "Production Standard," eliminate bottlenecks, and track feature statuses daily.
  • Issue Resolution: Use a best-in-class critical thinking mindset to identify, track, manage, and resolve project impediments quickly to ensure no "dangling threads" slow down
